meta.originalInput: Every day you delay a difficult conversation, you pay compound interest in anxiety. The mind imagines catastrophic outcomes to protect you from temporary discomfort. But avoidance does not freeze the problem in place; it quietly rots the foundation. Speak the truth while the stakes are still manageable.
